shortDesc: The signed-in member's reply notifications, newest first, with the unread count and a Mark all read button. Takes no data: it loads them itself. Use on /notifications.

styling.notes: Header line with the unread count and a pine text button; stack of g-notification-item.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'list my notifications', outputFormat: { unread, notifications: [{ id, type, postId, postTitle, commentId, fromName, excerpt, createdAt, read }] } }
{ intent: 'mark all my notifications as read', outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
